title: Flaky: VS Code extension dynamic debug configuration E2E teardown fails with EBUSY resource busy/locked on Windows
test_name: Aspire dynamic debug configuration E2E "after each" hook for "re-resolves the selected AppHost by dynamic configuration name in duplicate-alias workspaces"

error_pattern:
AggregateError: Dynamic debug configuration E2E teardown failed.
1. Error: EBUSY: resource busy or locked, rmdir 'C:\Users\runneradmin\AppData\Local\Temp\aev-YUBZdw\workspace\.e2e-dynamic-debug\first'
    at runE2eTeardown (out\test-e2e\test-e2e\helpers\fixtures.js:217:15)
analysis: The PR only modifies Aspire.Dashboard Razor/CSS files and Directory.Packages.props; it does not touch the VS Code extension or its E2E test fixtures/teardown code. The failure is a Windows-specific file-locking race condition (EBUSY on rmdir) during test fixture teardown, a known class of flaky/environmental issue on Windows where antivirus/file-indexing or a lingering child process briefly holds a handle on the temp workspace directory being removed. This is unrelated to the PR's Dashboard UI changes.
